## Wireless ADB: remembers your device
- Last connected IP and port are saved and pre-filled
- Auto-reconnects every 10 s when the device is missing or offline (pauses after Disconnect)
- Optional device name, shown with the IP below it in the device selector

## Text send: no more silent failures
- Spaces and special characters (`& ; | ' " $ ( )`) now send correctly
- Non-ASCII text (č, ć, š, ž, đ) is rejected with a clear message, adb `input text` cannot type it
- Uses the configured ADB server port
- Success or failure reason is shown under the Send button

## Logs
- Live search (tag, message, PID) and minimum level filter
- Level colors, line wrap, text selection, scrollbar
- Auto-scroll pauses when you scroll up, resumes at the bottom
- Copy visible lines
- No more UI freezes under heavy logcat output

See [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad/blob/main/CHANGES.md) for details.
